questions.question: A balanced three-phase load has 208 V line voltage and 10 A line current. What is the apparent power?
questions.explanation: Use S = √3 × EL × IL. S = 1.732 × 208 × 10 = 3602 VA. The apparent power is approximately 3.6 kVA.

questions.question: An SCR is best described as:
options: A resistor with no control terminal
A controlled rectifier that can latch on
questions.explanation: SCR means silicon-controlled rectifier. It conducts after a gate signal and remains on until current falls below holding current. SCRs are used in power control circuits.

questions.category: C4 - Use measuring and testing equipment
questions.question: You need to measure current in one phase of a three-phase motor without opening the circuit. Which tool is best?
questions.explanation: A clamp meter measures current by sensing the magnetic field around one conductor. It does not need to be connected in series. Only one conductor should be inside the clamp.

questions.category: D1 - Interpret plans, drawings and specifications
questions.question: A single-line diagram shows a 600 V service, transformer, MCC, and distribution panels. What is its main purpose?
questions.explanation: Single-line diagrams show power flow. They simplify services, transformers, panels, and feeders. They are important for planning and troubleshooting.

questions.category: H2 - Install three-phase consumer/supply services and metering equipment
questions.question: A 600Y/347 V three-phase service supplies lighting line-to-neutral. What voltage is used?
questions.explanation: In 600Y/347 V systems, line-to-neutral voltage is 347 V. Line-to-line voltage is 600 V. 347 V is common for commercial lighting.
